mapper.insert: insert ignore into corgi_user_recommend(user_id, rec_user_id) values(#{userId},#{recId})
mapper.update: update corgi_user_recommend set `weight` = `weight` + 1 where user_id = #{userId} and rec_user_id = #{recId}
update corgi_user_recommend set `status` = #{status}, opt_time = #{opt} where user_id = #{userId} and rec_user_id = #{recId}
mapper.select: select r.rec_user_id userId, d.nickname `nickname`, d.avatar avatar, d.avatar_status avatarStatus, d.avatar_check_status avatarCheckStatus, d.role role, d.hide_role hideRole, d.group `group`, d.hide_group `hideGroup`, d.hide_prefer_group `hidePreferGroup`, d.con con, d.relation, d.check_status checkStatus, d.weight, d.height, d.birthday from corgi_user_recommend r left join corgi_user_detail d on d.user_id = r.rec_user_id where r.user_id = #{userId} and r.`status` = '0' order by r.`weight` desc limit #{start}, #{size}
